oracle.assumption: Ahem at 10px gives each ASCII X and U+0020 an advance of 10 CSS px. CSS Text 4 break-spaces preserves spaces, allows wrapping after each preserved space, and does not hang end-of-line spaces.

scenes.reason: Two preserved spaces contribute 20px between two 20px words.
pre-wrap preserved spaces may hang after soft wrapping; the two words determine the 20px minimum.

The comment does not create a box; both source spaces remain in the single anonymous item.
Each word followed by a preserved space is a 30px fragment, so the 25px track overflows by 5px on each of two lines.
The two non-hanging spaces before LF remain in the first 40px line; the second line is 20px.
No spaces hang before the forced break; min-content wraps XX-space, the remaining space, then XX into three lines.
Trailing spaces wrap and remain measurable rather than hanging beyond the line.
Leading spaces are preserved and included in max-content sizing.
